title: He Robbed a Bank With a Bomb on His Neck — Victim or Accomplice?
description:
On August 28, 2003, pizza delivery driver Brian Wells robbed a bank in Erie, Pennsylvania with a metal bomb collar locked around his neck and a loaded shotgun concealed in his cane. He walked out with a fraction of the $250,000 demanded in a bizarre note that launched him on a timed scavenger hunt across town.

Nine minutes before the bomb squad arrived, the device detonated live on a news camera. Wells died in the street, surrounded by officers powerless to help. For years he was called a hostage — until the FBI revealed he may have helped plan the robbery before being betrayed by his own co-conspirators.

Mastermind Marjorie Diehl-Armstrong was convicted in 2010 and died in prison in 2017, still insisting there was more to the story. Some of the scavenger hunt clues have never been solved.
